text:
Aapki situation samajh sakta hoon, medical emergency ki wajah se aisi problem aa jaati hai. 

Lekin late penalty waive off karne ka authority mere paas systemically nahi hai. Iske liye main aapko ek human supervisor (human agent) se connect kar deta hoon, jo aapki request ko consider kar sakein.
